summary: The market heads into a one-day holiday on a firm note after banks rescued a volatile session, with softer oil helping but a heavy results day and US inflation data ahead.

detail.leaders: State-run banks and pharma, which led today's late recovery
detail.laggards: IT, after a day of profit-taking, and Whirlpool of India after its weak quarter
detail.tone: A forward-looking read: today closed modestly higher after a volatile day. Markets are shut on Tuesday, so the next session is Wednesday Nov 11, after US CPI data on Tuesday.
watch: US October CPI on Tuesday, for its read on a December Fed hike
Progress in US-Iran talks and its effect on oil
